meta.what: obs_integral update_law texts (rov_rl/obs_spec.integral_update_law, live = round 1, dev = the r2dev copy with the round-2 clauses) and the exporters' units string — what the station's rl_policy.obs_integral_law_text / OBS_INTEGRAL_UNITS_TEXT must equal (review F4)

texts.dev: per control tick (dt = control_dt), AFTER the estimator / observation guard / goal update and BEFORE the frame is assembled: e_pos_w = clip(p_goal_w - p_est_w, -obs_offset_clip, +obs_offset_clip) per world axis (world z-up; p_est_w = exactly the position offset_b uses); q_err = conj(q_est_f) (x) q_des_f with q_des_f / q_est_f = the frame's two quaternion slots (goal-heading frame when obs_goal_frame, w >= 0 canonicalization applied); e_att = 2 sign(q_err.w) (q_err.x, q_err.y) (roll, pitch error, body FLU: + = the hull must roll right-side-down / pitch nose-DOWN to reach the goal); I_pos = clip(I_pos (1 - dt / 4) + dt e_pos_w, +-0.4); I_att = clip(I_att (1 - dt / 4) + dt e_att, +-0.8) (leak, then add, then clip, per component). Slots: int_pos_b(3) = R(q_est_w)^T I_pos / 0.4 (q_est_w = the world-frame estimated attitude offset_b uses, not the goal-frame slot), int_att_rp(2) = I_att / 0.8. I_pos = I_att = 0 at engage / episode reset (whenever the history is refilled), BEFORE that tick's update, so the first frame already carries dt e.
